pikpak_login.title: PikPak login authorization
pikpak_login.loading: Opening the official login page and filling your credentials…
pikpak_login.waiting: Complete any CAPTCHA and confirm authorization in this window
pikpak_login.success: Refresh token filled in; PC platform and device ID applied. Save the storage to finish.

errors.credentials_required: Enter your email and password in the storage form first
errors.browser_unavailable: Chrome/Edge was not found on the server. Install it or set OPENLIST_PIKPAK_BROWSER
errors.browser_start_failed: Could not start an isolated browser on the server
errors.session_failed: Could not create a login session
errors.too_many_sessions: Too many login sessions; close another window first
errors.provider_unavailable: Cannot reach PikPak; check the server network
errors.unexpected_origin: The page left the trusted PikPak website; login stopped
errors.login_page_changed: The official login form could not be identified
errors.account_mismatch: The approved account does not match the entered email; token withheld
errors.account_unverified: The approving account could not be verified; token withheld
errors.missing_refresh_token: The authorization response contained no refresh token
errors.failed: Login failed; close the window and retry
errors.email_required: Enter your PikPak email in the storage form first

pikpak_login.device_tips: No Chrome/Edge is needed on the server. Sign in yourself on the official page; password autofill and page cropping are unavailable in this mode.
pikpak_login.browser_tips: Use the centered login card with automatic credential entry. Chrome/Edge is required on the server.
pikpak_login.device_waiting: Sign in with the email entered in the storage form and approve on PikPak. The token will be filled in automatically.

qrcode_115.title: 115 QR Code Login
qrcode_115.waiting: Scan with the 115 app and confirm login
qrcode_115.scanned: Scanned; confirm login on your phone
qrcode_115.expired: QR code expired; refresh to retry
qrcode_115.failed: Could not get Cookie; refresh to retry
qrcode_115.success: Cookie filled in; save the storage to apply it
